name: involve.me
summary: Interactive funnel builder: quizzes, calculators, assessments and payment pages with built-in email sequences, a CRM for the leads they capture, A/B testing between two versions, and an AI funnel builder metered in AI credits. Free tier to start; paid tiers are priced by the number of live funnels.
best_for: marketers building interactive lead-gen — quizzes, calculators, assessments and payment funnels with built-in email sequences — who want a free tier to validate the concept first
skip_if: you just need a simple form (lighter tools do that free), or you don’t yet have the traffic to feed an interactive funnel
honest_knock: The tier pages sell live funnels, but the meter that empties first is contacts. Start collects 300 contacts a month against 10,000 funnel visits — so a funnel converting at 3% hits the contact ceiling and the visit ceiling in the same week, and the next 200 contacts cost €8.33 on top. Those two meters appear only in the in-app comparison table; the public table publishes the AI-credit allowance but not visits or contacts. The free plan is documented in exactly one place, and not where you would look for it: the pricing FAQ caps it at 50 submissions or 500 visits a month and warns that your funnels lock until the next calendar month if you hit that without upgrading, while the plan cards say nothing at all about what it includes. We measured that part — 2 live funnels, involve.me branding, no team seats — and you only learn it by hitting the wall, because a free account has no usage panel: “Plans & Billing” goes straight to the upgrade page. And the honest fundamental for any interactive-funnel tool: quizzes and calculators convert traffic you already have — they don't create it, so validate on the free plan before the subscription outruns the pipeline.

pricing.plans_source: hand-curated from the vendor's pricing page
pricing.notes: (re-verified 19 September 2026 on the public pricing page; the free plan's feature set was measured inside the product, because the plan cards still do not state it) There is a free plan, and this is what it actually gives: 2 live funnels, publishing on a daanV.involve.me subdomain (or one of ten alternatives such as quizzes.cx, forms.ac and calculators.cx), the AI funnel builder, and involve.me branding on every page. No team seats at all. The pricing FAQ does publish the number that decides when it runs out: a free account runs to 50 submissions or 500 visits a month, and if you reach that without upgrading your funnels lock until the next calendar month starts. Paid, per person per month, annual against monthly: Start $29 / $49 with 3 live funnels and 1 user, Grow $69 / $99 with 5 funnels and 2 users, Scale $139 / $199 with 25 funnels, 5 users, A/B testing and lead verification. Enterprise is from $499/mo on annual contracts only. In the app the same tiers are priced in euros — €29, €69, €139 — and the annual toggle says “save up to 41%” where the public page says 40%. Two meters that decide more than the funnel count does are still missing from the tier pages: funnel visits a month (10,000 / 25,000 / 100,000) and contacts collected a month (300 / 1,000 / 3,000); the AI-credit allowance (50 / 100 / 300) is on the public comparison table. Each is toppable: +5,000 visits €8.33, +200 contacts €8.33, +250 AI credits €7.50, +1 seat €7.50, +5 live funnels €7.50. Prices exclude EU VAT. Every tier is higher than at the 17 Jul 2026 reading, when Start was $19/mo annual and $29 month-to-month.
